nodes.description: IOracle public state variable used to fetch USDC normalized pricing data for tokens.
IAddressesGenerator public state variable used to fetch asset addresses and asset count.
IDelegationMapping public state variable used to check whether an asset balance is delegated.
Constructor that wires the oracle, addressesGenerator and delegationMapping state variables.
Public view returning the number of assets from addressesGenerator.assetsLength().
Public view returning all asset addresses from addressesGenerator.assetsAddresses().
Public view that loops over a caller-supplied address array and builds an array of AssetTvlBreakdown structs.
External view that fetches asset addresses internally and delegates to assetsTvlBreakdown(address[]).
Public view computing the full TVL breakdown (token, balances, delegated, adjusted, USDC value) for one asset.
Public view accumulating USDC TVL over a caller-supplied address array, looping to assetsLength().
External view that fetches asset addresses internally and delegates to assetsTvlUsdc(address[]).
Public view computing USDC TVL for a single asset from adjusted underlying balance.
Public view returning static adapter metadata (id, typeId EARN, categoryId SAFE).
Public view casting a caller-supplied address to IEarnToken and reading token().
Public view casting a caller-supplied address to IEarnToken and reading calcPoolValueInToken().
Public view returning assetBalance(assetAddress) when delegationMapping reports the balance as delegated, else 0.
Subtraction adjustedBalance = underlyingBalanceAmount - delegatedBalanceAmount in assetTvlBreakdown; can revert on underflow.
Subtraction adjustedBalanceAmount = underlyingBalanceAmount - delegatedBalanceAmount in assetTvlUsdc; can revert on underflow.
External calls (token(), calcPoolValueInToken()) executed on a caller-supplied, potentially malicious asset address.
External oracle calls getPriceUsdcRecommended / getNormalizedValueUsdc whose results drive reported TVL.
